description: Disallow raw allocation/deallocation in C++ (use RAII + smart pointers).

patterns.label: new operator
patterns.message: Use std::make_unique/std::make_shared or RAII instead of raw 'new'.

patterns.label: malloc
patterns.message: Avoid malloc; use RAII containers or smart pointers.

patterns.label: calloc
patterns.message: Avoid calloc; use RAII containers or smart pointers.

patterns.label: realloc
patterns.message: Avoid realloc; use RAII containers or smart pointers.

patterns.label: free
patterns.message: Avoid free; use RAII containers or smart pointers.
